aria: Animated recap of the Magic's 115 to 105 road win over the Celtics: Desmond Bane's pull-up jumper with 1:33 left that made it 110 to 99, quarter-by-quarter scoring, Bane's 24 points and 8 rebounds, the top scorers, how the Magic won, and the next game.
notes: Box score from the Magic's 115–105 road win over the Boston Celtics at TD Garden on Nov 16, 2026, from the FantasyTeamAdvice box score, with game details from the Associated Press (Kyle Hightower, via CBS Boston, Boston.com and Fox Sports), NBC Sports Boston and VAVEL. All 115 Orlando points and all 105 Boston points are accounted for in the box score, and the quarter scores (20–30–25–40 to 17–24–36–28) add up to both totals: 50–41 Orlando at the half (AP) and 77–75 Boston after three (AP). Team totals (field goals 41 of 82 to 38 of 90, free throws 20 of 25 to 9 of 17, threes 13 of 34 to 20 of 56, rebounds 46–40, assists 30–23) are summed from the player rows; Orlando's 41 of 82 matches AP. Orlando's biggest lead, 11, is from NBC Sports Boston; Boston's is left out because the accounts differ. Records and ranks are from the site's standings after Monday's games.

Orlando won the fourth quarter 40–28 for its fourth straight win and ended Boston's six-game win streak; Boston was on the second night of a back-to-back (AP). Jayson Tatum had 24 points and 12 rebounds but also five of Boston's 11 turnovers (AP). The Magic host Philadelphia on Wednesday, Nov 18 (AP; tip time from SportBusy).

The play of the game is an original illustration of Desmond Bane's jumper with 1:33 left that gave Orlando a 110–99 lead, right after Franz Wagner's alley-oop to Wendell Carter Jr. (AP; NBC Sports Boston; VAVEL calls it a pull-up jumper). The recaps don't describe the spot or the move further, so it is drawn as the template's plain pull-up from mid-range. The figures are stylized and not traced from footage, and the spacing is not to scale.

The music is an original beat made for this page. No existing recordings or melodies are used. This is an unofficial fan recap, not affiliated with the Orlando Magic or the NBA, which is why it carries a plain basketball mark and the team's colors but not the team's logo.

The shooter in the play of the game is drawn to Desmond Bane's listed 6-foot-6 and 215 pounds with No. 3 (RealGM, Wikipedia), in Orlando's road blue. No wingspan is used, so his arms are drawn to the standard proportion. He has no approved look yet, so he is drawn as a team-colour silhouette. It is an original figure with a featureless face, not a portrait or a trace of footage.
